advance.summary: For supplied binary-spin graph energy H(x)=-sumJ_ij x_i x_j-sumh_i x_i, retain three same-temperature replicas and reassign their sitewise spin multisets jointly. At each mixed site let majority sign s_i and minority replica label c_i in{0,1,2}; x_i^(a)=s_i[1-2 1(a=c_i)]. Local-field and unanimous-site edges stay constant; mixed edges obey sum_a x_i^(a)x_j^(a)=s_i s_j[-1+4 1(c_i=c_j)]. Conditional recombination is exactly a signed three-state Potts law with coupling K_ij=4J_ij s_i s_j. Exact conditional heat-bath resampling preserves joint equilibrium but is not generally ergodic. This is an internally derived identity and scoped primitive, not a novel general solver or measured mixing advantage.
